items.requirement: Credential must include @context, type, validFrom, issuer, credentialSubject, credentialStatus
items.details: buildVCPayload includes all required fields. @context starts with W3C v2 and data-integrity v2 base URLs.

items.requirement: When mode=opencerts, add OpenCerts-specific contexts and types to @context array
items.details: In opencerts mode (line 383-388), baseContexts is extended with OPENCERTS_CONTEXT, OPENCERTS_SCHEMA_V2_CONTEXT, OPENCERTS_EXTRA_CONTEXTS, and OPENTRUST_DSS_CONTEXT. type becomes [VerifiableCredential, OpenCertsCredential].

items.requirement: credentialSubject fields must follow canonical OpenCerts mapping
items.details: toOpenCertsCredentialSubject maps recipientName->name, recipientEmail->email, certificateId->certificateId via OPEN_CERTS_SUBJECT_FIELD_MAP constants.

items.requirement: credentialSubject._type must be present for OA recognition in OpenCerts mode
items.details: Line 368 sets _type to 'OpenCertsIssuer' (OPENCERTS_SUBJECT_TYPE constant). This signals the credential type to OA verifiers.

items.requirement: credentialStatus must be an array with OpenAttestationDocumentStore type pointing to on-chain contract
items.details: Lines 407-414 build credentialStatus as array element. id uses did:ethr:<contract>#<documentId> format required by OA v2 verifiers.

items.requirement: Contract must be deployed on supported Ethereum network with DocumentStoreRegistry ABI
items.details: Currently uses demo contract 0x92600b6B5fE4D15D87d7d264C6cAdCcaf9D74594 on Sepolia (testnet). For production, deploy own document store per TradeTrust deployment guide.

items.requirement: Must publish TXT record at _document-store.<domain> matching contract address and network
items.details: Current config uses 'verifiable.sg' as identity proof location. Must add TXT record: Name=_document-store.verifiable.sg, Value='openatts net=ethereum netId=11155111 addr=<contract>'.

items.requirement: credentialStatus.revocation must specify OCSP_RESPONDER with valid OCSP endpoint
items.details: Uses sandbox OCSP URL from env var. For production, provision real OpenAttestation OCSP responder or TradeTrust's production OCSP endpoint.

items.requirement: Remote OA contexts must be loadable during signing
items.details: Codebase embedded all required OpenCerts/OA JSON-LD contexts inline (OPENCERTS_CONTEXT, OPENCERTS_SCHEMA_V2_CONTEXT) to eliminate network dependency.

items.requirement: OpenCerts types must appear before standard W3C contexts in some verifiers' resolution order
items.details: baseContexts array puts OpenCerts contexts at positions 2-5 after base URLs, ensuring availability during type resolution.

items.requirement: credentialSubject must include $template for OA renderer lookup
items.details: getTemplateForCertificateType matches certificateType against CERTIFICATE_TEMPLATES. Result added as $template.name and $template.version. All three types use EMBEDDED_RENDERER on certificates.openattestation.com.

items.requirement: Issuer DID must resolve to a valid DID document at the specified domain
items.details: Uses did:web:verifiable.sg. Must ensure https://verifiable.sg/.well-known/did.json exists with correct public key/verificationMethod.

items.gap: Production document store contract not deployed
items.recommendation: Deploy DocumentStoreRegistry smart contract on target network per TradeTrust deployment guide.

items.gap: DNS-TXT identity proof record not yet published
items.recommendation: Add TXT DNS record at _document-store.<your-domain> matching deployed contract address and network ID.

items.gap: did:web DID document for verifiable.sg not created
items.recommendation: Create .well-known/did.json at verifiable.sg domain containing issuer's public key used for signing.
Replace sandbox OCSP URL with production endpoint after document store is deployed.
Extend OPEN_CERTS_SUBJECT_FIELD_MAP to include additional OpenCerts template fields if needed.
